items.title: K-flatness satisfies the two-out-of-three property for short exact sequences of complexes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the two-out-of-three property for K-flat complexes in a short exact sequence, under the additional hypothesis that the third complex is flat in every degree, and the proof is a 19-line argument that tensors the sequence with an arbitrary complex and inspects the resulting sequence of total complexes. The exactness of that sequence is checked degreewise, where the degreewise exactness follows from the flatness hypothesis through the vanishing of Tor, and then the conclusion is reduced to the elementary fact that in a short exact sequence of complexes acyclicity also satisfies two out of three. Both the degreewise reduction and the final step are displayed.
